newsitem.title: USA: Invacare sees Q2 EPS meeting estimates.
newsitem.headline: Invacare sees Q2 EPS meeting estimates.

text.p: Invacare Corp said on Thursday that it expects to report second quarter sales up four percent and that the company would meet Wall Street analysts' expectations of $0.33 per share.

Invacare said in a news release that its top-line growth was hurt by about four percent in the quarter by a slowing in sales to a large national account. Sales were reduced by another two percent by the dollar's strength against European currencies.
Price competition continued to intensify in the second quarter, the company said, but it expects to meet Wall Street's earnings expectations due to aggressive cost control.
Invacare makes home health care products and mobility products for people with disabilities.
